content.json:
# FlashCardSage Usage
How many people use FlashCardSage and what they do with it, from Application Insights.

- **Active users** are the people whose requests reached the API: each request from someone signed in is tagged with their user ID, which shows as the authenticated user. The service user the smoke tests and load test sign in as is never tagged, so it isn't counted.
- **Users**, and their cards, decks, tags and practice results, come from the latest **usage snapshot**: the API reads them from the database and logs one row per person at most every 6 hours, and only while someone is using the app, so it never wakes the paused database. Practice results on deleted cards are deleted with them, so they aren't counted.
- **Lifetime averages** divide each person's practice results by the time since they signed up (at least a day, or a month for the monthly one), then average over people.
- Practice results, pictures and imports are counted from the requests that succeeded. Application Insights keeps 30 days of telemetry, so nothing here goes back further.

content.query:
let snapshot = traces
| where isnotempty(customDimensions.UsageUserId)
| extend SnapshotAt = todatetime(customDimensions.UsageSnapshotAt), UserId = toint(customDimensions.UsageUserId),
    SignedUp = todatetime(customDimensions.UserCreatedAt);
let lastSnapshot = toscalar(snapshot | summarize max(SnapshotAt));
let people = snapshot | where SnapshotAt == lastSnapshot | summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by UserId;
let active = requests | where timestamp > ago(30d) and isnotempty(user_AuthenticatedId);
union
    (print Order = 0, Metric = 'Users', Value = tostring(toscalar(people | count))),
    (print Order = 1, Metric = 'New users (past 30 days)', Value = tostring(toscalar(people | where SignedUp > ago(30d) | count))),
    (print Order = 2, Metric = 'Daily active users (past day)',
        Value = tostring(toscalar(active | where timestamp > ago(1d) | summarize dcount(user_AuthenticatedId)))),
    (print Order = 3, Metric = 'Monthly active users (past 30 days)', Value = tostring(toscalar(active | summarize dcount(user_AuthenticatedId))))
| order by Order asc
| project Metric, Value

requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} and isnotempty(user_AuthenticatedId)
| make-series ['Active users'] = dcount(user_AuthenticatedId) default = 0
    on timestamp from startofday(todatetime('{TimeRange:startISO}')) to todatetime('{TimeRange:endISO}') step 1d
content.title: Daily active users
content.noDataMessage: Nobody signed in during this period.

content.query:
let snapshot = traces
| where isnotempty(customDimensions.UsageUserId)
| extend SnapshotAt = todatetime(customDimensions.UsageSnapshotAt), UserId = toint(customDimensions.UsageUserId),
    Cards = toint(customDimensions.CardCount), Decks = toint(customDimensions.DeckCount), Tags = toint(customDimensions.TagCount);
let lastSnapshot = toscalar(snapshot | summarize max(SnapshotAt));
let people = snapshot | where SnapshotAt == lastSnapshot | summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by UserId;
union
    (print Order = 0, Metric = 'Average cards per user', Value = tostring(toscalar(people | summarize round(avg(Cards), 1)))),
    (print Order = 1, Metric = 'Average decks per user', Value = tostring(toscalar(people | summarize round(avg(Decks), 1)))),
    (print Order = 2, Metric = 'Average tags per user', Value = tostring(toscalar(people | summarize round(avg(Tags), 1)))),
    (print Order = 3, Metric = 'Snapshot taken', Value = iff(isnull(lastSnapshot), '', strcat(format_datetime(lastSnapshot, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), ' UTC')))
| order by Order asc
| extend Value = iff(isempty(Value) or Value == 'NaN', 'No snapshot yet', Value)
| project Metric, Value

traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(customDimensions.SystemDeckName)
| join kind=inner (requests | where timestamp {TimeRange} and isnotempty(user_AuthenticatedId) | distinct operation_Id) on operation_Id
| summarize Imports = sum(itemCount) by ['Built-in deck'] = tostring(customDimensions.SystemDeckName)
| order by Imports desc
content.title: Imports of each built-in deck
content.noDataMessage: Nobody imported a built-in deck during this period.

content.json: **Per active user** divides the practice results by everyone who used the app in that time, not only the people who practiced.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} and isnotempty(user_AuthenticatedId)
| where name startswith 'POST' and resultCode == '200'
| where tostring(parse_url(url).Path) matches regex @'^/api/flashcards/\d+/practice-results$'
| make-series ['Practice results'] = sum(itemCount) default = 0
    on timestamp from startofday(todatetime('{TimeRange:startISO}')) to todatetime('{TimeRange:endISO}') step 1d
content.title: Practice results per day

content.query:
let snapshot = traces
| where isnotempty(customDimensions.UsageUserId)
| extend SnapshotAt = todatetime(customDimensions.UsageSnapshotAt), UserId = toint(customDimensions.UsageUserId),
    SignedUp = todatetime(customDimensions.UserCreatedAt), Cards = toint(customDimensions.CardCount),
    Decks = toint(customDimensions.DeckCount), Tags = toint(customDimensions.TagCount),
    PracticeResults = toint(customDimensions.PracticeResultCount);
let lastSnapshot = toscalar(snapshot | summarize max(SnapshotAt));
snapshot
| where SnapshotAt == lastSnapshot
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by UserId
| extend LifetimeDays = max_of(1.0, (lastSnapshot - SignedUp) / 1d)
| extend LifetimeMonths = max_of(1.0, LifetimeDays / 30.4)
| join kind=leftouter (
    requests
    | where timestamp > ago(30d) and isnotempty(user_AuthenticatedId)
    | summarize LastActive = max(timestamp) by UserId = toint(user_AuthenticatedId)
) on UserId
| project User = UserId, ['Signed up'] = SignedUp, ['Last active'] = LastActive, Cards, Decks, Tags,
    ['Practice results'] = PracticeResults, ['Per month'] = round(PracticeResults / LifetimeMonths, 1),
    ['Per day'] = round(PracticeResults / LifetimeDays, 1)
| order by ['Practice results'] desc, User asc
content.title: Each user in the latest snapshot
content.noDataMessage: No usage snapshot in the last 30 days.

content.json: Users are shown by their ID in the database, never their name or email. **Last active** is blank for anyone who hasn't used the app in the last 30 days.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} and isnotempty(user_AuthenticatedId)
| where name startswith 'POST' and resultCode == '200'
| where tostring(parse_url(url).Path) == '/api/flashcards/images/generate'
| make-series ['Pictures generated'] = sum(itemCount) default = 0
    on timestamp from startofday(todatetime('{TimeRange:startISO}')) to todatetime('{TimeRange:endISO}') step 1d
content.title: Pictures generated per day
content.noDataMessage: No pictures were generated during this period.
